app.title: Minar
app.tagline: One island. Four lessons. One goal.

plan.name: Plan & Budget
plan.hook: Needs, wants, and a plan for every ₹.

save.name: Save & Manage
save.hook: Two bad weeks are coming. Ready?

invest.name: Understand Investing
invest.hook: Risk, time, and a little magic called compounding.

safe.name: Stay Financially Safe
safe.hook: Spot the scam before it spots you.

hud.walkHint: Use the joystick, arrow keys, or tap to walk. Step up to a place to go in.
hud.keysHint: Arrow keys / WASD to walk · Enter to go in
hud.illustrative: Illustrative amounts. Not real offers or advice.
hud.resetConfirm: Erase all progress on this device?

school.name: School student
school.blurb: Class 12. Saving for coaching and exam fees.

college.name: College student
college.blurb: First year done. Tuition and hostel are next.

earner.name: First-generation earner
earner.blurb: First job. Family counts on you. Saving for a skills course.

b1.title: One year. One goal.
b1.caption: Hyderabad, early morning. A quiet island, and a long way to go.

b2.title: Who is heading out?
b2.caption: Pick the person you will be this year.

b3.title: Nani's flower stall
b3.caption: She places a small cloth bundle in your hands.
b3.quote: This is what we could save. The rest is up to you.

b4.title: The goal
b4.caption: Your fee is due in 12 months. Let's earn the rest.

story.rotate: Turn your phone upright to play the story.

b5.title: The bazaar opens
b5.caption: Four doors. Four lessons. All yours.

places.title: Four places, four skills
places.caption: Each place on the island teaches one skill. Visit all four.

win.title: Light the flags
win.caption: Finish a place and its flag turns gold, and the goal bar fills. Finish all four and the college gate opens.

happy.title: Stay happy
happy.caption: A short break keeps your Happy Index up, so lessons count in full. Tap a place to walk there, drag to look around, pinch to zoom.

play.comingSoonBody: This lane of the bazaar opens soon. For now, the lamp on the minaret can be lit with the button below.
play.done: Lamp lit! Head back to the Charminar.
play.rewindNote: Rewind is coming: every mistake can be retried, no penalty.

recap.heading: Recap
recap.sampleBody: Every time you pick one thing, you give up another. Naming that trade-off makes the next choice easier.

celebrate.title: Goal reached
celebrate.body: The college gate is open. Well done.

dashboard.title: Goal reached
dashboard.body: You made it. The college gate is open.

island.gateLocked: The gate opens when all four lessons are done.

host.exitConfirm: Leave this game? Progress inside the game may not be saved.
host.errorBody: Something went wrong. Your progress so far is safe.
host.banner: Made-up numbers. Real life is different.

penalty.title: Some pillars count for less
penalty.body: Your Happy Index was low when you finished {{count}} of your pillars, so {{amount}} is held back.
penalty.how: To recover: take a short break with a life moment, then replay a pillar to brighten it. A replay can only make a pillar better.

happy.title: Happy Index
happy.tiredNote: You have finished {{count}} games in a row without a break. A short break looks after you and lifts your Happy Index.

toast.title: Your Happy Index is getting low
toast.body: A pillar finished while Happy is low counts for less. Take a short break, then replay to brighten it.

moments.title: Look after yourself
moments.gainFaded: Little effect now: it fades when repeated

chai.name: A chai with friends
chai.description: A quick catch-up over a hot drink.

restAtHome.name: Rest at home
restAtHome.description: An evening to rest and recharge.

balance.title: You and your future
balance.why: Finishing pillars fills your goal meter. Looking after yourself keeps your Happy Index up, so your pillars count fully. You need both.

next.none: Finish a pillar to start filling your goal meter.
next.allWork: Try a short break: a life moment lifts your Happy Index.
next.balanced: Keep this rhythm: finish a pillar, then take a short break.
next.selfHeavy: Your goal meter is falling behind: finish a pillar to catch up.

wire.title: Wireframe index (dev)
wire.intro: Every wireframe screen and component. Use the DEV panel to change Happy and clear pillars and watch them update.

problem.title: The Goal
problem.body: Your fee is due in 12 months. Let's earn the rest.

win.title: How to win
win.body: Finish a pillar, earn its badge, fill the goal meter. Finish all four and you've earned your fee.

happy.title: Stay Happy
happy.body: Money isn't everything. Look after yourself, or your badges count for less.

controls.title: How to move
controls.text: Drag to walk, tap to enter.

goal.title: Your Goal
goal.body: Each finished place fills the goal bar. All four open the college gate.

closing.allBright: All four places are bright. Keep taking breaks.
closing.someDim: Some places are dim. Replay them to brighten them.
closing.keepGoing: Finish all four places to open the gate.

home.tagline: Learn money, one lane at a time.
home.title: Minar
home.shareBody: Send this code to your teacher or NGO facilitator so they can see how the class is doing.
home.shareWhat: It shares your progress, skills, Happy score and language. It never shares your name, your alias or anything you typed.

money.title: Your money
money.spent: You spent {{x}} on looking after yourself.
money.spentHint: Chai and treats cost a little and lift your Happy.
money.h1: Each of the four places is worth a quarter of the way to your goal.
money.h2: Finish a place and its lamp lights. How bright it is depends on how happy you are at that moment.
money.h3: Play a place again to brighten its lamp and add the rest.
money.start: You started with {{x}} from your family.

lamp.bright: Bright lamp (Happy 60 or more): the full amount

happy.title: How happy you are
happy.scale: Lamps shine bright at 60 or more, dim from 35, and flicker below that.
happy.tired: You have played {{count}} games in a row. A short break will help.
happy.u1: Chai with friends, a festival treat, rest at home.
happy.u2: Treats you chose in games, helping a friend, a balanced month.
happy.d1: Finishing a game. It tires you out a little.
happy.d2: Saying no to every treat for a long time, or falling for a scam.
happy.w1: A place finished while you are happy adds more money.
happy.w2: That is why looking after yourself is part of the plan.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.skills: What you are getting good at
profile.share: Share my progress with my teacher

settings.title: Settings
settings.lightHint: Less animation. Good for older phones.
settings.classHint: Ask your teacher. Leave it empty if you do not have one.
settings.resetHint: Erases this game's progress on this device.
settings.about: Minar. All amounts are made up, for practice.
